thread:
elaine: Hey team — Zephyr POC (trial key z-03) is getting intermittent 429s during a bulk embeddings import. It happens after about ~15 minutes. Can we triage?

jordan: Got it. Do we have a request_id from a failing call? Also which route are they hitting (embeddings vs chat)?

elaine: Request IDs: req_8f3a and req_8f3b. They call /v1/embeddings with a CSV of ~10k rows using 10 parallel workers.

mike_oncall: 10 parallel workers + long import -> likely token budget or per-route cap. Can you share the tenant id and whether this is hosted or dedicated?

nora_zephyr: tenant id 7642. This is hosted trial. We tried to space requests but still saw bursts. Their app spawns 10 workers each doing 1-2 requests/sec.

jordan: Ok. On hosted we have per-route soft caps + global token budget. quota-bot just posted this alert:

quota-bot: "Alert: tenant 7642 exceeded per-route burst window twice in the last 10m. 429s returned. Route: embeddings.create. Current token rate 1.2k/s"

mike_oncall: That matches. Two quick mitigations: 1) reduce concurrent workers to 4-6; 2) use the batch-embedding endpoint (larger batch per request) to reduce per-request overhead. Both non-invasive.

jordan: Also short-term we can bump their per-route soft_limit (not SLA-backed) for the demo. If sales approves we can do a one-off +temporary override. Elaine, can you confirm approval from Zephyr to accept a soft bump and potential extra charges?

elaine: They said demo needs to finish by EOD. Approve soft bump for today. Keep me posted on cost delta.

mike_oncall: I'll apply a +2x soft_limit for embeddings.create for tenant 7642 for 3 hours. Patch applied. Expect smoothing in ~30s.

jordan: Sharing quick diagnostic curl for failures — please run and paste output if it fails again:

```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-compact","input":["sample text"],"batch_size":128}'
```

elaine: Ran that after the bump, still saw a single 429 (req_8f3c) but then back to 200s.

mike_oncall: That's expected — in-flight requests can get 429 while cache and token accounting settle. If they see persistent 429s after 2 mins, escalate.

jordan: Long-term: recommend per-tenant reservation or Dedicated for predictable throughput. Also we should add to presales doc a checklist: expected concurrency, batch strategy, estimated tokens/min.

elaine: Noted. Also the finance question: will the soft bump count towards trial credits or be billed?

mike_oncall: Soft bump will consume tokens from their trial credit pool. If they exceed free credits, we'll flag for billing outreach. I'll annotate the tenant record.

nora_zephyr: Thanks — we'll throttle workers to 5 for now and retry the import. Appreciate the quick help.

jordan: Filed a short follow-up ticket for eng: include request_id req_8f3a/8f3b/8f3c + logs + tenant 7642 so we can check the token_accounting trace.

elaine: Perfect. Closing the immediate swarm. Follow-up items: eng trace, presales checklist update, and runbook note about short-lived soft bumps. :thumbsup:

mike_oncall: Will add runbook note. Leaving the temporary override until 3 hours are up.

quota-bot: "Info: temporary override applied to tenant 7642 (embeddings.create) until +3h by mike_oncall"

elaine: Thanks everyone — will update Zephyr and confirm if they convert to a paid pilot later today.
